<script>
export default ({
  data() {
    return {}
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <v-container fluid class="fill-height">
    <v-row align="center" justify="center">
      <v-col cols="12" sm="8" md="4">
        <v-card class="elevation-12">
          <v-toolbar dark color="primary">
            <v-toolbar-title>Login form</v-toolbar-title>
            <v-spacer></v-spacer>
          </v-toolbar>

          <v-card-text>
            <v-form>
              <v-text-field
                  prepend-icon="mdi-account"
                  name="email"
                  label="Email"
                  type="email"
              />
              <v-text-field
                  id="password"
                  prepend-icon="mdi-lock"
                  name="password"
                  label="Password"
                  type="password"
              />
            </v-form>
          </v-card-text>

          <v-card-actions>
            <v-spacer></v-spacer>
            <v-btn color="primary">Login</v-btn>
          </v-card-actions>
        </v-card>
      </v-col>
    </v-row>
  </v-container>
</template>

</style>
